title: Service level objective definition
description: One versioned, measurable SLO for a platform service, per REFERENCE_ARCHITECTURE.md section 2 and docs/requirements/ACCEPTANCE_TARGETS.md's latency/load/recovery targets. Defines the objective, not a result; P10.02 registers these, P10.04 alerts against them.

measurement_query_ref.description: Pointer to the exact PromQL/log query implementing this measurement; the query itself is not embedded in the contract.

related_acceptance_target_id.description: An ID from docs/requirements/ACCEPTANCE_TARGETS.md this SLO operationalizes, e.g. 'LAT-02'.
